name: When do I need a general contractor for a kitchen expansion?

mainEntity.name: When do I need a general contractor for a kitchen expansion?

acceptedAnswer.text: You need a general contractor for a kitchen expansion project because it involves significant structural changes, plumbing and electrical work, and requires navigating complex permitting processes. A general contractor manages all aspects of the project, including design coordination, hiring and overseeing subcontractors, managing timelines and budgets, and ensuring compliance with local building codes. This expertise is crucial for a successful and compliant expansion, especially in areas like San Bruno or South San Francisco with specific building requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general contractor is essential for kitchen expansions due to structural changes, complex permits, and managing various trades to ensure compliance and project success.
